indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX offer_pkey ON public.offer USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_offer_user_id ON public.offer USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_offer_user_id_idempotency ON public.offer USING btree (user_id, idempotency_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_offer_slug ON public.offer USING btree (slug)
CREATE INDEX idx_offer_feed ON public.offer USING btree (created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_offer_user_feed ON public.offer USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_offer_feed_visible ON public.offer USING btree (created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (image_count >= 1)
CREATE INDEX idx_offer_user_feed_visible ON public.offer USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (image_count >= 1)
CREATE INDEX idx_offer_title_search ON public.offer USING gin (title_search) WHERE (image_count >= 1)
CREATE INDEX idx_offer_feed_currency_price ON public.offer USING btree (currency, price, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (image_count >= 1)
CREATE INDEX idx_offer_category_created ON public.offer USING btree (category, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (image_count >= 1)
